LanguageData.BOR_SunsteelTile.label: sunsteel tile
LanguageData.BOR_SunsteelTile.description: Sunsteel flooring, just as one might find among one of many Solar Republics. Its design evokes a stoic, interstellar journey - a far cry from those today claiming solarite lineage.

LanguageData.BOR_QuasarTile.description: Kwazaari flooring, just as one might find in kwazaari trade outposts.
